import type * as React from "react" import { cn } from "@/lib/utils" import dryShampoo from "./images/dry-shampoo.webp" import fashion1 from "./images/fashion-1.webp" import fashion5 from "./images/fashion-5.webp" import fashion6 from "./images/fashion-6.webp" import fashion7 from "./images/fashion-7.webp" import fashion8 from "./images/fashion-8.webp" import fashion9 from "./images/fashion-9.webp" import fashion10 from "./images/fashion-10.webp" import lipstick from "./images/lipstick.webp" function assetSrc(asset: string | { src: string }) { return typeof asset === "string" ? asset : asset.src } const DEFAULT_IMAGES = [ { id: 1, src: assetSrc(fashion5), alt: "Fashion portrait five" }, { id: 2, src: assetSrc(fashion7), alt: "Fashion portrait seven" }, { id: 3, src: assetSrc(fashion1), alt: "Fashion portrait one" }, { id: 4, src: assetSrc(dryShampoo), alt: "Dry shampoo product" }, { id: 5, src: assetSrc(fashion10), alt: "Fashion portrait ten" }, { id: 6, src: assetSrc(fashion6), alt: "Fashion portrait six" }, { id: 7, src: assetSrc(fashion9), alt: "Fashion portrait nine" }, { id: 8, src: assetSrc(fashion8), alt: "Fashion portrait eight" }, { id: 9, src: assetSrc(lipstick), alt: "Lipstick product" }, ] as const export type GalleryImage = { id: number src: string alt: string } export default function Gallery({ title = "People", description = "Access a wide range of people photos designed to enhance your templates, presentations, and modern web projects, helping you create engaging and visually appealing designs with ease.", ctaLabel = "More pictures", ctaHref = "#", images = DEFAULT_IMAGES, className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"section"> & { title?: string description?: string ctaLabel?: string ctaHref?: string images?: readonly GalleryImage[] }) { return (
